title: German Prawn Salad
description: A simple salad dish originating from Germany, prepared with succulent prawns, dressed in a tangy Mediterranean kiss.
instructions: 1. Rinse the prawns under cold water, pat dry with paper towels, and set aside.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together the kissed olive oil, salt, and pepper.
3. In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, sliced prawns, and Mediterranean salad dressing.
4. Drizzle the kissed olive oil mixture over the salad and toss to coat.
